name: awesome-anti-censorship
desc: curated list of open-source anti-censorship tools

resources.name: Zerodrop
resources.desc: Open-source stealth URL toolkit optimized for bypassing censorship filters.

resources.name: tor
resources.desc: The Tor network is a group of volunteer-operated servers that allows people to improve their privacy and security on the Internet. Tor's users employ this network by connecting through a series of virtual tunnels rather than making a direct connection

resources.name: i2p
resources.desc: I2P is an anonymizing network, offering a simple layer that identity-sensitive applications can use to securely communicate. All data is wrapped with several layers of encryption, and the network is both distributed and dynamic, with no trusted parties.

resources.name: hidden lake
resources.desc: Hidden Lake is a decentralized anonymous F2F (Friend-to-Friend) network with theoretical provability based on queues (QB task).

resources.name: vuvuzela
resources.desc: Vuvuzela is a messaging system that protects the privacy of message contents and message metadata. Users communicating through Vuvuzela do not reveal who they are talking to, even in the presence of powerful nation-state adversaries.

resources.name: whonix
resources.desc: Whonix is an operating system focused on anonymity, privacy and security. It's based on the Tor anonymity network, Debian GNU/Linux and security by isolation. DNS leaks are impossible, and not even malware with root privileges can find out the user's real IP.

resources.name: tails
resources.desc: Tails is a portable operating system that protects against surveillance and censorship.

resources.name: shadowsocks
resources.desc: a fast socks5 proxy that encrypts traffic

resources.name: v2ray
resources.desc: A platform for building proxies to bypass network restrictions

resources.name: obfsproxy
resources.desc: Tor framework for implementing pluggable transports (anti-censorship network tunnels)

resources.name: obfsproxy with OpenVPN
resources.desc: OpenVPN traffic obfuscation using obfsproxy

resources.name: flashproxy
resources.desc: miniature proxy that runs in a web browser, and reflects traffic to a Tor relay.

resources.name: meek
resources.desc: Tor pluggable transport that uses HTTP for carrying bytes and TLS for obfuscation.

resources.name: lantern
resources.desc: Lantern is a free desktop application that delivers fast, reliable and secure access to the open Internet for users in censored regions

resources.name: algo
resources.desc: Set up a personal VPN in the cloud

resources.name: MTProxy
resources.desc: Proxy server which helps telegram users who are inside censored areas still be able to connect to telegram

resources.name: streisand
resources.desc: single command set for a server running a wide variety of anti-censorship software

resources.name: WireGuard
resources.desc: WireGuard is an extremely simple yet fast and modern VPN that utilizes state-of-the-art cryptography. It aims to be faster, simpler, leaner, and more useful than IPSec, while avoiding the massive headache. It intends to be considerably more performant than OpenVPN.

resources.name: tunsafe
resources.desc: TunSafe is a fast and modern layer 3 VPN tunnel that implements the new and modern WireGuard protocol that is becoming increasingly popular in the VPN community due to its security, speed, reliability and ease of use. TunSafe was developed with the goal to bring the power of the WireGuard-protocol to all the Windows users around the world and in March 2018 the first version was released.

resources.name: scramblesuit
resources.desc: Tor pluggable transport that uses look-like-nothing traffic as a cover channel

resources.name: FTE
resources.desc: fteproxy provides transport-layer protection to resist keyword filtering, censorship and discriminatory routing policies

resources.name: telex
resources.desc: involves placing anticensorship technology into the Internet's core network infrastructure, through cooperation from large ISPs.

resources.name: uproxy
resources.desc: uProxy is a browser extension that lets friends route their connection to their Internet through each other's computers. It can help people with restricted or insecure access to the Internet get to the content they care about safely.

resources.name: NaïveProxy
resources.desc: NaïveProxy uses Chrome's network stack to camouflage traffic with stronger censorship resistence and less detectablility than custom-made network stacks (Shadowsocks and variants, V2Ray suite, handmade Golang stacks).

resources.name: gost
resources.desc: GO Simple Tunnel - a simple tunnel written in golang

resources.name: obfs4
resources.desc: the newest version of the Tor obfsproxy obfuscation proxy. implements multiple pluggable transports.

resources.name: trojan
resources.desc: An unidentifiable mechanism that helps you bypass GFW

resources.name: govpn
resources.desc: Simple secure VPN daemon, aimed to be reviewable, secure, DPI/censorship-resistant.

resources.name: gohop
resources.desc: A VPN implemention in golang, with crypto and obfuscation in nature.

resources.name: Dust
resources.desc: A Polymorphic Engine for Filtering-Resistant Transport Protocols

resources.name: marionette
resources.desc: Marionette is a programmable client-server proxy that enables the user to control network traffic features with a lightweight domain-specific language.

resources.name: chnroutes
resources.desc: modifies the route table to route only censored ips through vpn

resources.name: firefly-proxy
resources.desc: A proxy software to help circumventing the Great Firewall.

resources.name: iodine
resources.desc: This is a piece of software that lets you tunnel IPv4 data through a DNS server. This can be usable in different situations where internet access is firewalled, but DNS queries are allowed.

resources.name: obfuscated-openssh
resources.desc: Handshake obfuscation strengthens the initial SSH handshake against systems that identify or classify various network protocols by examining data in transit for static signatures.

resources.name: infranet
resources.desc: Infranet is a system that attempts to circumvent web censorship by allowing clients to surreptitiously request sensitive content via cooperating Web servers distributed across the global Internet.

resources.name: fwlite
resources.desc: A powerful HTTP proxy server designed to circumvent the Great Firewall (GFW)

resources.name: code-talker-tunnel
resources.desc: Code Talker Tunnel (previously called SkypeMorph) is a protocol camouflaging tool, designed to reshape traffic output of any censorship circumvention tool to look like Skype video calls

resources.name: stegotorus
resources.desc: StegoTorus, a tool that comprehensively disguises Tor from protocol analysis. To foil analysis of packet contents, Tor's traffic is steganographed to resemble an innocuous cover protocol, such as HTTP.

resources.name: go-packetflagon
resources.desc: A local HTTP application that serves customised Proxy Auto Configuration files for your browser to help bypass Internet censorship.

resources.name: Firezone
resources.desc: Self-hosted VPN server using WireGuard. Supports MFA, SSO, and has easy deployment options.

resources.name: Hedioum Pool Tunnel
resources.desc: A high-performance anti-DPI tunnel in Go that disguises VLESS/Trojan traffic as SSH, TLS/HTTPS, SMTP/IMAP or a DirectAdmin panel, with dynamic connection pools and real Let's Encrypt certificates.

resources.name: Stunning
resources.desc: Multi-protocol tunneling engine with composable anti-DPI plugin chains (TLS/HTTP mimicry, padding, traffic morphing) and access-control gates, written in Go.

resources.name: amneziawg-installer
resources.desc: Automated one-command setup of AmneziaWG 2.0 VPN on Ubuntu & Debian — an obfuscated WireGuard fork with DPI bypass, client management, and server hardening.

resources.name: ipfs
resources.desc: IPFS is a global, versioned, peer-to-peer filesystem (awesome list)

resources.name: dat
resources.desc: a decentralized tool for distributing data (awesome list)

resources.name: ZeroNet
resources.desc: Decentralized websites using Bitcoin crypto and the BitTorrent network

resources.name: sovereign
resources.desc: Censorship resistant democracies.

resources.name: tribler
resources.desc: Privacy enhanced BitTorrent client with P2P content discovery

resources.name: AKASHA
resources.desc: next-generation social media network immune to censorship by design. It is built on top of Ethereum using Smart Contracts and IPFS

resources.name: twister
resources.desc: twister is an experimental peer-to-peer microblogging software.

resources.name: freenet
resources.desc: Freenet is a peer-to-peer platform for censorship-resistant communication.

resources.name: Disroot
resources.desc: Disroot is a platform providing online services based on principles of freedom, privacy, federation and decentralization.

resources.name: ooni-probe
resources.desc: OONI Probe network measurement tool for detecting internet censorship https://ooni.io

resources.name: mongol
resources.desc: A simple python tool to pinpoint the IP addresses of machines working for the Great Firewall of China.

resources.name: ChinaDNS
resources.desc: Protect yourself against DNS poisoning in China.

resources.name: https://github.com/gfwlist/gfwlist
resources.desc: Great Firewall of China ban list

resources.name: gfw_whitelist
resources.desc: A Pac File of the Whitelisted Websites for the Great Firewall of China (GFW)

resources.name: antizapret
resources.desc: List of Russian government's IP addresses.

resources.name: BlockCheck
resources.desc: A script that detects what kind of blocking (DNS, IP, DPI) your ISP is using (for Russia).

resources.name: GoodbyeDPI
resources.desc: Passive Deep Packet Inspection blocker and Active DPI circumvention utility (for Windows)

resources.name: DPITunnel
resources.desc: DPI Tunnel is an application for Android that uses various techniques to bypass DPI (Deep Packet Inspection) systems, which are used to block some sites.

resources.name: Geneva (Genetic Evasion)
resources.desc: Novel experimental genetic algorithm that evolves packet-manipulation-based censorship evasion strategies against nation-state level censors.

resources.name: Voidly Censorship Index
resources.desc: Real-time global censorship analytics aggregating 19.6M live OONI samples, 1.6M historical records, IODA outage alerts, and CensoredPlanet probes across 119+ countries. Surfaces 5,356 citable incidents (DNS poisoning, TCP-resets, blockpages, BGP outages), an ML-driven shutdown early-warning model, and free REST/MCP APIs for researchers and tool developers (CC BY 4.0).

resources.name: DissidentX
resources.desc: DissidentX is encoding messages in files on the web.

resources.name: PixelKnot
resources.desc: image steganography for Android.

resources.name: cachebrowser
resources.desc: CacheBrowser is a system designed to help Internet users bypass Internet censorship. The core idea ofCacheBrowser is to grab censored content cached byContent Delivery Networks such asAkamai andCloudFlare directly from their CDN edge servers, therefore, foiling censors' DNS interference.

resources.name: rubberhose
resources.desc: Julian Assange's deniable-encryption filesystem.

resources.name: OnionShare
resources.desc: tool that lets you securely and anonymously share a file of any size (over TOR).
